name: Wicca
overview: Scripture clearly condemns Wicca and related practices such as witchcraft, enchantments, and consulting familiar spirits, as seen in commands like "Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live" (Exodus 22:18) and prohibitions against using enchantments or observing times (Leviticus 19:26). The Lord warns against seeking after wizards or familiar spirits, declaring that those who do will be cut off from their people and face severe judgment (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6, 27). These passages emphasize God's holiness and the necessity for His people to avoid all forms of occultism and divination, affirming that such practices are incompatible with faithful obedience to Him (Deuteronomy 18:10).
